articles.title: Millions of Kids Now Have Trump Accounts, but New Rules Raise Questions
articles.summary: More than 60 million children were automatically given Trump Accounts, but new rules about donated stocks are raising questions.

articles.title: Judge Says White House Cannot Ban News Outlets Over Their Coverage, for Now
articles.summary: A judge ruled that the White House cannot ban CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters because of their coverage, at least until a trial.

articles.title: Massachusetts Voters Will Decide Whether Towns Must Allow Smaller Homes
articles.summary: Massachusetts voters will decide whether towns must allow homes on smaller lots to help ease a housing shortage.
